$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. CI (`scripts/audit-check.mjs`) fails on any
high/critical advisory NOT listed here, and fails on any listed exception
whose `expires` date has passed — so an exception can never quietly become
permanent. Every entry must state why the vulnerable code path is

exceptions.reason: Transitive via @nestjs/platform-express, which pins multer to an exact 2.2.0 in both v11 and v12 — no dependency-version choice avoids it. All four advisories are denial-of-service in multipart/form-data parsing. ACC exposes no multipart route in Phase 1: no controller uses FileInterceptor/FilesInterceptor and no multer middleware is registered, so the parser is never invoked. Re-evaluate before Phase 8+ introduces media upload.
